description: F7 rule 7 golden: B3 signal-aware pacing (iap.execution.pacing; API_TRADING.md section 2.14): pacing_scale cases (z null = no reading), apportion cases, tilted_slice_qty cases, and the replay's POV pacing accumulation per step (_schedule_signal: scale, p_eff = min(p * scale, max_participation), rate = p_eff / (1 - p_eff) under pov_exact else p_eff, target_f += rate * dV, target = floor(target_f)). The slice block runs the accumulation over the real TRADEs with the planted readings and tilts the pinned 8-slice curves.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

slice.rule: a sample is taken after applying the k-th event (1-based) whenever k > prefix_events and k % sample_every == 0
slice.readings_rule: a reading after every 50th event (1-based ordinal) past the prefix whose book is two-sided: ts = the event's exchange_ts, expected_return = (bid_sz - ask_sz) / (bid_sz + ask_sz) * 1e-4 of the consolidated L1 after the event, z = iap.execution.signal.zscore over those expected returns; equal timestamps keep the last reading
slice.pov_rule: every TRADE event past the prefix accumulates, z = the reading at the event's exchange_ts (latency 0, no staleness), one accumulation per run; every 20th trade (n_trades) is recorded
slice.tilt_rule: weights = slice_weights of an 8-slice TWAP / VWAP / IS (risk_aversion 1) parent; scale_k = pacing_scale(buy, z at the k-th sample's exchange_ts); the remaining qty of 10000 is re-apportioned at every slice with tilted_slice_qty
